text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With the Holy Hoof Festival fast 
approaching, the students are bustling 
about making preparations. Meanwhile, 
Symboli Kris S—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I plan... to take part in— preparing—our 
class's presentation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
As a student—of Tracen Academy— I want to 
find—my purpose... and dedicate 
myself—until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The experience of working continuously 
alongside other students is irreplaceable. 
It will surely become a treasure of her 
academy life.

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Class Rep! We have a noise complaint on 
the field! We need to deal with this 
immediately...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nwoh, I wanna rush to the scene— but my 
hands are tied right now...! The sign 
painting is... aghh!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I will help.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? For real!? Then could ya paint this 
part blue for me?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nwooooooh, problem solved in record time!! 
Thanks a bunch for helpin' with the paint! 
All good now!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...I, see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Panel transport complete.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ that was heavy... But thanks to you, 
we got it done in one trip~ Saved my 
life~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: See ya. Let me return the favor sometime~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did Symboli Kris S make it back in time to 
help with her class's preparations? 
Worried, I went to check on her, andâ

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "—Beverage order complete. So, —..."

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so fast...! Um, that was a huge 
help. Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: So, how'd it go... not so well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. —It seems my role here—is no longer 
needed.
choice_data_list: No! That's not it at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In truth, I am able to get tasks from my 
classmates. But once one is finished, 
that's the end of it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Constantly communicating with those around 
her and participating as just another 
member... seems difficult at present. If 
that's the case—
choice_data_list: Shall we head to the student council?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why you're free right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
If I have no role to play— I shall take my 
leave.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—No. I'm ashamed to admit it, but the 
Student Council is currently buried under 
a mountain of tasks for managing the Holy 
Hoof Festival."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'd appreciate a helping hand. What do you 
say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list:
So Symboli Kris S's role was here all 
along, huh.

So Symboli Kris S's role was here all 
along, wasn't it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――……Yeah, I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I will give it... my all. So—tell me 
anything you need."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be in very high spirits. 
That's extremely encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, there are two tasks we're 
short-handed on: passing messages to each 
class, and placing orders... I'd like you 
to handle one of them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. Either way... I am prepared—to 
execute the mission, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, acting as a messenger would mean 
communicating with other students, which 
could prove to be a real barrier. Which 
role would be better to take on...?
choice_data_list:
Why don't you take charge of the ordering 
duties?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Acknowledged. ...No hesitation—I will... 
execute the order.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—An announcement, it is. Regarding the 
application... for after-school work.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah...! Make sure to submit the 
application properly, got it. Well then, 
with that settled—

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Huh? I-Is something wrong...?
choice_data_list:
If you're ever busy, I'm more than happy 
to help out. Alright?

If you're ever busy, I'm more than happy 
to help out. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ah..., —Ah. If there's—anything, —I'll 
take care of it.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! Th-Thank you...! To be honest, I 
was swamped with work. If you're offering 
to help, I'd love it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S's intentions finally 
reached her classmates a little. Relieved, 
I watched over her work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: “—I see. —Leave the ordering—to me.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list:
(She's blazing through that paperwork at 
incredible speed...!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Impressive as always. Completely 
prepared for every conceivable issue—this 
order sheet covers every single detail."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Heh, you truly haven't changed one bit, 
Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ever since she was little, she was 
the very picture of deep contemplation, 
apparently. According to her master, at 
least.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even when a squabble over the machines 
broke out at her club, she appeared to 
just stand by silently, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Upon asking for more details, it turned 
out she had devised a remarkably fair set 
of rules."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Her thoughtfulness is a virtue that 
shines even within a team. When the time 
comes that it's needed— I want you to 
support her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quietly hoped the day would come when 
she could display that exceptional work 
ethic among her classmates as well.
